```{r}
library(tseries)

# ARMA(1,1) with GARCH(1,1) errors
garch_gen <- make_garch_gen(alpha0 = 0.1, alpha = 0.15, beta = 0.8)
result <- gen.aruma.tse(n = 500, phi = 0.7, theta = 0.3, innov_gen = garch_gen, sn = 42)
result

m1 <- est.arma.wge(result$y, p = 1, q = 1)

garch_fit_tseries <- garch(m1$res, order = c(2, 2), trace = FALSE)
summary(garch_fit_tseries)


```


```{r}

library(rugarch)

# Generate GARCH(1,1) data
garch_gen <- make_garch_gen(alpha0 = 0.1, alpha = 0.15, beta = 0.75)
result <- gen.aruma.tse(n = 2000, phi = 0.7, d = 1, theta = -.2, innov_gen = garch_gen, plot = FALSE, sn = 123)
resid <- residuals(arima(result$y, order = c(1, 1, 1)))

# Fit multiple GARCH orders
spec_11 <- ugarchspec(variance.model = list(garchOrder = c(1, 1)),
                      mean.model = list(armaOrder = c(0, 0), include.mean = FALSE))
spec_21 <- ugarchspec(variance.model = list(garchOrder = c(2, 1)),
                      mean.model = list(armaOrder = c(0, 0), include.mean = FALSE))
spec_12 <- ugarchspec(variance.model = list(garchOrder = c(1, 2)),
                      mean.model = list(armaOrder = c(0, 0), include.mean = FALSE))
spec_22 <- ugarchspec(variance.model = list(garchOrder = c(2, 2)),
                      mean.model = list(armaOrder = c(0, 0), include.mean = FALSE))

fit_11 <- ugarchfit(spec_11, data = resid, solver = "hybrid")
fit_21 <- ugarchfit(spec_21, data = resid, solver = "hybrid")
fit_12 <- ugarchfit(spec_12, data = resid, solver = "hybrid")
fit_22 <- ugarchfit(spec_22, data = resid, solver = "hybrid")

# Compare
cat("Model Comparison:\n")
cat(sprintf("GARCH(1,1): AIC = %.4f, BIC = %.4f\n", infocriteria(fit_11)[1], infocriteria(fit_11)[2]))
cat(sprintf("GARCH(2,1): AIC = %.4f, BIC = %.4f\n", infocriteria(fit_21)[1], infocriteria(fit_21)[2]))
cat(sprintf("GARCH(1,2): AIC = %.4f, BIC = %.4f\n", infocriteria(fit_12)[1], infocriteria(fit_12)[2]))
cat(sprintf("GARCH(2,2): AIC = %.4f, BIC = %.4f\n", infocriteria(fit_22)[1], infocriteria(fit_22)[2]))


```
